name: Dong Lan Nan Zi Ti Yu Xue Yuan Yue Xian
original_name: 东岚男子体育学院 越线
source:
You play as Xu Yanchuan, a disciplined and restrained student who believes every movement should have a clear purpose. After entering Donlan Men's Athletic Academy, he meets Jiang Ye—a sharp, unpredictable fighter who always manages to disrupt his rhythm. What begins as irritation and technical conflict gradually turns into recognition, attraction, and a dangerous closeness neither of them knows how to handle.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4688470/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演徐彦川，一个遵守纪律、内敛的学生，相信每一个动作都应该有明确的目的。进入唐兰男子体育学院后，他遇到了江野——一个敏锐、难以捉摸的战士，总是能扰乱他的节奏。一开始的恼怒和技术冲突逐渐变成了认可、吸引，以及一种他们都不知道如何处理的危险的亲密关系。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4688470/]Steam[/url]]
